0022600177.text: The Knicks host the Chicago Bulls in their eighth game of the season, with New York at 3-4 and eighth in the East, 3.5 games behind for fourth in the Atlantic, after winning their last game. Chicago is 1-6 and 13th in the East, 5 games back in the Central, and has lost five straight, including 0-2 at home. Josh Hart (ankle) is out for New York, and Nic Claxton (hamstring strain) is out for Chicago. The Knicks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 133-127 win in Chicago on October 28, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
